description: This source file is a shell script used for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures in an OpenWrt build environment. It defines functions to check the firmware image and perform upgrades for different board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is suitable for the detected board by inspecting the bootloader version string.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process tailored to specific board types, including extracting files and setting partition variables.
